unit.source: S105 (states 清代营造尺 1尺=320mm; the 丈尺册 conversions in S111, S113, S114 use the same value)
unit.note: Heights: eave_m and ridge_m are above ground; column_m is above the platform; eave_m = platform + column (box top); eave_tip_m = eave_m - 0.5 x overhang (roof edge at 五举); platform_edge_m = 下出, the platform beyond the eave column line. Run: scripts/rules.py in /opt/data/cache/scratch/palace_r1b_typology.

plan_scale.ground_scale: 4.77 px/m, about 1:1070, rotation 7.2 deg, locally 3.7-5.55 px/m (research/georef/princeton-1920s.json, 111 points); Malone's 1:1300 = 3.94 px/m does not hold for the ground
plan_scale.use: Position from the ground fit. A hall box measured on the plan: frontage = px/4.2, depth = px/3.3, then snap bays to the class. A stated size in by_name wins.

grand_hall.zh: 七至九间正殿 (朝会大殿)
grand_hall.tiles: grey 布瓦, unless by_name says glazed
grand_hall.derivation: Round 11 (Q182, Q183): column and platform are the medians of the class's measured halls, not of the audience hall: columns 慎德堂 YM03-11 4.35, 保合太和殿 YM02-08 4.48, 慎修思永 YM23-01 4.0, 田字殿 YM20-01 3.68 (median 4.17); platforms 0.59, 0.96, 0.55 (median 0.59) (S310 Yangshi Lei figures as transcribed, S137, S139; research/scenes/dimensions.csv, method a). Bays 5.17 / 4.83 / 4.32 m: the yellow slip of NLC 样001-4 for 正大光明殿, 明间 1.615丈, 次间 1.51丈, 梢间 1.35丈 (S310). 正大光明殿 keeps its own column 5.12 m and platform 1.22 m through by_name. Roof steps and 举 from the rule, so ridge is C: rise 5.40 as before; ridge = 0.59 + 4.17 + 5.40 + 0.36 + 0.25 = 10.77 (scripts/typology_rules.py). Round 1 values were column 5.12, platform 1.22, bays 5.50 / 4.70, ridge 12.38: those of 正大光明殿 alone.

main_hall.roof: 卷棚歇山 or 卷棚悬山
main_hall.derivation: Bays 观澜堂 13/12 chi (S111). Column 3.70 from 万字房 3.68 (S113); rule 0.8 x 4.16 = 3.33, 观澜堂 has 4.32. Platform between 0.58 and 0.96. Three-roll halls: repeat the section, each roll 7.55 m deep (S111, 观澜堂). Depth is C. Arithmetic: inner 6.40 = 2x2x1.39 + top 0.83; rise = 1.60x0.5 + 1.39x0.65 + 1.39x0.85 = 2.89.

side_hall.roof: 卷棚硬山 or 卷棚歇山
side_hall.derivation: Column 3.10 and platform 0.54 taken from 松风阁 (S111), bay by the 0.8 rule (3.84 x 0.8 = 3.07). East and west 朝房 of 长春园 are five-bay grey 卷棚歇山 (S112). Arithmetic: inner 4.48 = 2x2x0.97 + top 0.58; rise = 1.28x0.5 + 0.97x0.65 + 0.97x0.85 = 2.10.

small_house.roof: 卷棚硬山 or 卷棚悬山
small_house.derivation: Bays 10/9 chi (藏密楼, S111); depth 12 chi + two 4-chi porches (惠如春, 松风阁, S111); column 2.75 (惠如春); 土地庙 column 8 chi on a 10 chi bay is the rule exactly (S114). 6-purlin rolled section, 五举 + 七举 (S101). Arithmetic: inner 3.84 = 2x1x1.48 + top 0.89; rise = 1.28x0.5 + 1.48x0.7 = 1.67.

gallery.derivation: Bay 2.67 m is 728 m / 273 bays at 颐和园长廊 (S120, a comparable); 2.88 (9 chi) used. Width and column 2.4 are guesses; the plan draws galleries as one row of bays, so length comes from S01 and the bay is only the texture. Arithmetic: inner 2.24 = 2x1x0.86 + top 0.52; rise = 0.00x0.5 + 0.86x0.7 = 0.60.

pavilion_square.roof: 攒尖 or 重檐攒尖
pavilion_square.tiles: grey by default; glazed in the formal groups
pavilion_square.derivation: 吕祖亭 single bay with surrounding porch, 21 chi = 6.72 m overall (S114). Stele pavilion platform 14 chi = 4.48 m at 文源阁 (S105). 方亭 has its own juan in the 1734 text (卷二十二, S100), rule numbers not read. Column is C. Arithmetic: inner 4.48 = 2x2x1.12; rise = 1.12x0.5 + 1.12x0.7 + 1.12x0.9 = 2.35.

gate_hall.derivation: 大宫门 5 bays, platform 21.57 x 11.33 x 0.77 m (S102); 长春园宫门 five bays, grey 卷棚歇山 (S112). Column and bays are C (rule). Arithmetic: inner 8.96 = 2x2x1.95 + top 1.17; rise = 0.00x0.5 + 1.95x0.65 + 1.95x0.85 = 2.92.

temple_hall.zh: 祀庙正殿 (重檐, 琉璃)
temple_hall.tiles: yellow glazed; 舍卫城 and 佛楼 may differ
temple_hall.derivation: Rule with doukou 2.5 cun = 0.08 m (S101 quoting 工程做法): central bay 7 x 11 x 0.08 = 6.16, next 5.28, then reduced to fit 安佑宫's plan (9 bays confirmed, 143.6 px = 34 m at 4.2 px/m). Column 70 doukou = 5.60 incl. plate and brackets. Ridge below is single-eave; double eave: 7.00 + 3.0 upper column (guess) + 4.91 + 0.61 = 15.5 m. Arithmetic: inner 12.80 = 2x3x2.13; rise = 1.60x0.5 + 2.13x0.65 + 2.13x0.75 + 2.13x0.9 = 5.71.

storeyed_hall.roof: 卷棚歇山 or 硬山
storeyed_hall.derivation: 藏密楼 lower column 3.20, upper 2.30, platform 0.32 (S111); 同乐园南楼 3.20 and 2.40, platform 0.42 (S103). Top: 0.45 + 3.20 + 2.30 = 5.95; rise 1.67 and allowance 0.47 as small_house = 8.09. 文源阁 reads two storeys outside, three inside (S105).

tower.tiles: green with yellow edge at the comparable 畅音阁; at 清音阁 unknown
tower.derivation: 清音阁 is the only stated case: 3 storeys, 3 bays each face, ground to ridge 23.94 m (S103, B). Comparable 畅音阁 20.71 m (S121, a comparable). Footprint 64 x 54 px on S01 = about 14 x 13 m at the hall scale. Tier heights are guesses.

pavilion_polygon.roof: 六方 or 八方攒尖; 重檐 on stele and shrine pavilions
pavilion_polygon.derivation: Forms: 揽翠亭 单檐六方 (S111), 月地云居 八方重檐 (S122). Size only from S01: an octagon near 九洲清晏 at plan (3760, 4445) is 33 px across = about 7.5 m. Heights copied from the square pavilion.

garden_wall.confidence: B for height, C for thickness
garden_wall.derivation: Height about 2.8 m and the 12.6 m gap between the double walls on W, N, E: S116. South either side of 大宫门 single. No thickness found: 0.8 m is a guess.

spirit_wall.derivation: 41.6 m (S102). Malone measured 137 ft (41.8 m) long, over 5 ft thick, about 15 ft high (S02 p.69). Not drawn on S01.

pailou.derivation: 长春园牌楼门 column 5.12 m (S123). 安佑宫 three-bay glazed 火焰牌楼 and 8 m 华表 (S122). Three-bay, six-post form with two infill walls at 鸿慈永祜: S118.

shop.derivation: 含经堂 and 同乐园 shops about 3.20 x 4.80 m (S115). Column by the rule.

bridge.derivation: Length and position from S01. Forms: 三孔 and 五孔 timber deck bridges, stone pier and brick arch later (S111). Deck width 3 m and height 1 m above water are guesses.

paving.derivation: 大宫门 axis road 23 px wide on S01 = about 5 m. Eaves drip courses of pebble mosaic (散水) and 40 cm floor tiles: S104.

正大光明殿.note: Ridge from the rule, C. 1744 leaf: no terrace; 月台 12丈 x 4.63丈 x 0.8尺 = 38.40 x 14.82 x 0.26 m with four censers added 1775-1793 (S119). Plan: x 3230.6-3382, y 5415-5472.5.

大宫门.forecourt_terrace: 月台 on S01 98 x 46 px

观澜堂.note: Built about 1817, so in the 1860 state. S111 quotes 《圆明园百景图志》. Plan: x 8107.9-8205.6, y 3682.9-3765.5.

藏密楼.parent: YM36 per S111; S111 notes 百景图志 puts it under YM31
藏密楼.note: S111 depth 2.56 + porch 0.96 does not fit the plan's 5 rows: x 7133-7202, y 1455-1533. Surveyed 1858.

松风阁.parent: YM36 per S111; beside 藏密楼

田字房.note: Excavated 2022. The Yangshi Lei drawing made wells larger than rooms, the excavation shows them smaller (S104); S01 repeats the drawing (43.5 px wells, 24.5 px rooms). Do not take its geometry from S01 alone. 33 rooms with a 3.8 m well does not fit a simple grid: open. Plan: x 3378-3552.5, y 2430-2593.5.

万字房.note: S113 gives the same 33 rooms of 4.48 m that S104 gives 田字房, and S01 draws these rooms at about 14 px against 24.5 px there, so the figures may be borrowed. Provisional. Plan: x 1932.5-2082, y 3274-3410.5.

安佑宫.note: Form B (S122, S06, modelled on 景山寿皇殿). Plan 143.6 px = 34 m at 4.2 px/m. No stated size found. Plan: x 921.9-1065.5, y 1104-1173.5.

文源阁.roof: disputed: 硬山 per S105, form unsettled
文源阁.tiles: black glazed, green edge (excavation confirms black)
文源阁.note: Plan shows the narrow west bay, x 3473.5-3597.4, y 1445.9-1502. Built 1775 on the site of 四达亭. 丈尺册 dates from the Guangxu reign (S105). S105 also says the plan is close to 文津阁 and 文溯阁, about 26 x 15 m: unresolved.

文源阁碑亭.roof: 重檐攒尖 or 盔顶, inferred by S105

清音阁.confidence: B for height, bays, platform and columns; C for the tier heights between them
清音阁.note: Round 11 (Q184): the tower's figures from the Yangshi Lei drawing as transcribed on mhymy 7297 (S310): lower bays 5.50 and 4.51 m, 3 x 3 bays square (14.52 m, which matches the 中层檐内通见方 14.53 m), platform 0.96 m, 下出 1.12 m, columns 4.42, 3.71 and 2.72 m by storey, ridge 23.94 m (S103 gives the same). The plan's block read 14 x 13 m (C) before. 养吉斋丛录's 'about ten 丈' (32 m, S202) may count the whole stage court: still open. Plan: x 4736-4800, y 2929-2983.

澹怀堂.roof: 卷棚歇山, single 翘重昂 brackets
澹怀堂.confidence: B for form, C for size
澹怀堂.note: S112 and the plan (5 bays, 125.6 px) against S06's 九楹: five used. Plan: x 10975-11100.6, y 4456-4556.

方壶胜境 (group).what: OSM ruins polygon of the terrace
方壶胜境 (group).tiles: blue, yellow, green glazed, storeyed, marble terrace

XY01.floors: three levels: ground 7 bays, second 7, top 3
XY01.wings: 9-bay curved corridors to two-storey octagonal music pavilions
XY01.cornice: main, corridor and pavilion cornices at one level (2 cm difference, measured)
XY01.box: main 28 x 14 x 12 m + corridors 20 x 4 x 6 + octagons d 8 x 11
XY01.note: Forms B (S108). Footprint is an OSM ruins polygon, boxes inferred. S01 draws no main building here: a fountain figure at (8877, 1093), labelled nothing.

XY02.box: two-storey 10 x 8 x 9 m + one-storey north wing
XY02.note: S02 p.143: small two-storey with north wing, one storey. S01 block about 44 x 97 px at (8703, 1087), identification inferred.

XY03.note: Southern gate of the maze, stone bridge inside (S109). 37 px on S01.

XY04.centre: octagonal pavilion on a round stair base: ring d 20 m, pavilion d 10 m
XY04.confidence: B for walls, C for plan
XY04.note: S109 walls. Stated areas conflict: 89 x 59 m (S06, uncited) and 15000 sq m (S109). Used S01: 350 x 470 px at 4.77 px/m, x 8710-9060, y 420-890. Today's pavilion is white marble from the 1980s rebuild; the original was timber with a glazed roof (S109). Modelling the walls in plan needs tracing.

XY05.note: Peacock cage; west front in engraving 6, torn down about 1924 (S02 captions after p.145). Size is a guess.

XY06.box: 13 x 11 x 11 m with curved stairs either side
XY06.note: Form B (S06). OSM polygon includes the terraces. Block 60 x 53 px on S01.

XY07.box: five pavilions, 6 x 6 x 5 m, with galleries

XY08.box: west main block 19 x 44 x 13 m, tank block as above, east block 22 x 26 x 9 m
XY08.confidence: B for tank, C for boxes
XY08.note: Plan central strip 130 px = 4.75 px/m on the tank length, which fits the ground scale. Boxes scaled at 4.77 px/m from the plan: x 9801-10261.

XY09.form: centre three bays set back, three storeys under a double-eave hip roof; ends two-tier clock-pavilion roofs
XY09.note: Form B (S109). Plan x 10517-10615, y 780-865. OSM polygon includes the terrace.

XY10.towers: two 13-tier square fountain towers, each in a pool
XY10.note: Plan oval 137 x 92 px. Height a guess; ruins survive: check against S130-159 site work.

XY11.box: throne platform 12 x 6 x 1 m + screen 15 x 1 x 5 m

XY12.note: Plan label 转马台, outer ring 191-197 px at local scale = 42 m (Round 6; 38 m read at 4.77 px/m before). Height 8 m in S310, 7.4 m on plate 18.

XY13.note: Plan label 螺蛳牌楼. Guess.

XY14.note: OSM polygon of today's water; S01 647 x 253 px is a little wider N-S.

XY15.box: seven pairs of screen walls, each 6 x 1 x 5 m
XY15.note: Plan label 线法画. Sizes a guess.

_xiyang_lou_round6: For the Xiyang Lou this block now only seeds the rows: research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv holds the massing, research/xiyanglou/dimensions.csv every figure, and evidence/facts.csv `correct` rows replace the sizes (Round 6).
_how_to_use: Stated size in by_name or xiyang_lou wins; else S01 px / hall scale (frontage 4.18, depth 3.31 px/m); bay COUNT from S01; heights, roof and bay split from the class. scripts/build_r1.py applies this. by_name is keyed by Chinese name because hall ids came later.
